steps.name: ominous omen
steps.objective: Obtain an <Ancient Artifact Fragment> from the [Suspicious Imperial Guard Knight] in the "Southern Plains of El Anor" and report it to "Jade".

steps.name: Messy El Anor
steps.objective:
1. 'After talking with [Jade] in the "Infinite Corridor", check the messy contents with the [Guild Union Guard] in the "Guild Union". 
2. After talking to the [Guild Alliance Guard] in the "empty sea", go to [Rena Hiren] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You got this from imperial soldiers...? ?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Magical Artifacts is not my major... This style appears to be from the [2nd Age].

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The 2nd era... . Before a full-scale conflict occurs between the ancient gods and the demonic world... It was a peaceful but somewhat faded era. It is said that it was an anxious time, when darkness gradually ate away at people's weak hearts and corrupted them.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: … The relic you brought in itself is nothing special, but there are traces that something with very powerful magical power was buried with it.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That's probably what the imperial army took. What exactly is the object they took?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: … … I have an ominous feeling.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Now, please inform the residents of the contents of this proclamation.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: Old! All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… ? Proclamation?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Einst. What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ah… There has been an accident in the El Anor mountainous area, so I am warning residents to be careful when passing near it for the time being.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Hmm, I don't think it would be a particular problem for you... . If you ever have to go, be careful.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Through the open sea, you can go to the outskirts of the mountainous area surrounding the plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Our Union soldiers are on guard, so follow their guidance and be careful not to go too deep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What's going on?

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: This is the road leading to the El Anor mountainous area. It is currently in a state of great confusion due to an accident in which an Imperial airship crashed.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: It won't stop you from passing, but it's very dangerous. Still, I hope you go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll have to go back first and see what's going on. Let's go to the bar...)

steps.name: Request from the Empire and Guild Alliance
steps.objective: Defeat the [Imperial Knight Captain] in the "Knight Captain's Room" in the "Airship Crash Zone" and report to [Lena Hiren] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: The person in question has arrived.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I see… %s, come here for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, hello, Lena. Mr. Einst. What's going on?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Hello. I'd like to entrust you with a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Request?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Yes, this is what I was supposed to do, but circumstances arose.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: So, you can think of this as an official request from the empire.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Also, since we are also fully cooperating with the Empire regarding this matter, please consider it as a request from the Guild Alliance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… … . What kind of request is this?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You may be aware of our empire's [Knights of Guerrilla], which has been causing chaos in this area for some time now.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: After investigating, I found out that this army's identity is a reconnaissance unit that lost contact with its home country some time ago.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Did they betray the empire, or were there any circumstances, and what was their purpose? It's one of my jobs to find out.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: I haven't had a chance to do any research until now, but a chance arose.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: The flagship of this reconnaissance unit crashed at the foot of the mountainous region surrounding the plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: I don't know the cause yet. … I have a feeling that I may have received compensation for recklessly flying through the Guild Alliance's territory, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: … If you think that the Guild Alliance attacked the imperial ship, all I can say is that you are mistaken.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Hmm, I think flexible decision-making according to the situation is the strength of the Guild Alliance... Of course, I'm not saying this because I'm particularly suspicious, so I hope you won't be offended, Lord Einst.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It's okay. haha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...It somehow feels like a conversation between a raccoon and a fox...)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Well, anyway, this is a golden opportunity. Go to the airship crash site, find the commander of the [Blue Orca], and capture him alive. And if you find anything, please let me know.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … … Of relics… Preparation... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Old. It's over. Here… .

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … good night. certainly… To carry out the mission... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Old. From now on, we will begin the transport mission of this excavated item.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … … After a time of hardship... … . Open the door to destruction now... . Everything… . Let it burn with the master's anger... … .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: (From the captain... I get a bit of a strange feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a knight over there who seems to have a high status. Is that person the commander of the imperial army?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … Evil energy... I feel it!

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: !! Oh my, the enemy has come this far... . I will buy time. Please stay away.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … Nothing to worry about... .

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … You find a gap and escape... Carry out your mission… .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Yes, old.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: … … Little guys... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's coming, everyone be careful!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I guess that's how it ended. The soldier from earlier... I missed it. this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … In that soldier's arms, there was also a tool with some ominous magical power.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Wow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, you seem to be coming to your senses. Hmm, should I tie him up so he doesn't go wild... .

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Ugh, what on earth is this… . Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This person’s mood has changed. The evil energy has disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Hmm, is it an intruder? Did you know that this is the [Blue Killer Whale] blessed by the Queen of the Sylvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Stop the futile resistance! otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: This Maximilien Hadonfar Vlamediath Haronak Dondekman Darth Vader Villo III, I will punish you resolutely in the name of a knight!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (……the name is long….)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Wait, wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Lena, Mr. Einst.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: It's been a while, Lord Bjor.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Aren’t you the daughter of the Hiren family? How come you are in a place like this?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Lord Bjor, these are my friends and allies of the Empire, not enemies.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: And I am here to follow Her Majesty's wishes... To find you.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Yes? me... . You mean?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: That's right. Why did you break military discipline and turn your back on the imperial flag, and what consequences did you hope this would lead to? The Queen is curious.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Yeah? What, what are you saying!

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: This Maximilien Hadonfar Vlamediath Haronach Dondekman Darth Vader Villo III, I have not forgotten my duty as an Imperial Knight even for a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (……If you look closely, there is a word in the name that is hard to believe….)

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Uh, why did the queen have such suspicions about me... . I just can't figure it out.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Hiren… He's serious.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: … … Is that so? If [Beholder] says so, it must be true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Beholder?)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Well, Sir Björ. If so, let me ask.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Why did you lose contact with your home country? What did you do while you were hidden? Why did you invade El Anor Plains, the territory of the Guild Alliance? What artifacts were unearthed here?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: … Yeah?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Me, I don't understand what you're saying. To carry out my regular mission, I headed to the unit on my usual patrol course... .

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: … Towards… ?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Yeah... And then suddenly appeared… Enter the huge [gate]...

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Gate… ?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: … … that… In a beautiful plain covered with flowers... . I met someone… But… .

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: There… . He said… … … Ugh, ugh… . My head… .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Don't think any further than that.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Einst, I still need to hear more from you.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Remnants of powerful and evil magic still bind him. It would be dangerous to press him now.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: … … Hmm.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Let's go back to the village and get help from the wizards and paladins. The first priority is to restore your mind and body.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Okay. It's a relief to know that Lord Bjor and his troops are not traitors.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: That goes for us too. I will decline to clash swords with the Empire in earnest. haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes!

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: It was a great help. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Haha, not much to say. I'm glad it helped.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: It seems that you and your friends are exactly what the Queen predicted... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What now... ?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Oh, no. soliloquy.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: ('Foresight'... is probably the story of the 'power' possessed by the queen of the empire... Is there something planned in their fate that she will pay attention to?)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You guys deserve to hear how things happened. I'll be sure to let you know once I know more about the situation.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: I have a feeling that I will see you guys often in the future.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Then… See you later.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh yes, see you later.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: … Boo… .

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Maximilien Hadonfar Vlamedies Haronak Dondekman Darth Vaders Villot III. The biggest crisis... … !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (……Hmm, if the knight captain who fought me earlier was not in his right mind… there must be a culprit that put him in that state. Who is he? What is his purpose?)

steps.name: Request one more time
steps.objective:
1. 'Accept the request from [Lena Hiren] at the "Guild Inn" and go to the "Belfar Library" in the "Void Sea". 
2. After talking with [Fell] and [Liz], kill [Ifrit] in the “Magic Book Reading Room”. Then come back and report to [Pell].

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, you… I had a lot of trouble the other day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh hello Lena. Mr. Einst. Lord Bjor.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Jade is there too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Bjor, are you feeling better now?

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh yes. This bijo-le. The body is health itself.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: I think there's something wrong with my head... . (sullen)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Self, Lord Björ, there is no need to blame yourself like that.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The Queen will not rebuke you.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Haha… It is even more regrettable and disgraceful to receive the consideration of Her Majesty the Queen... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Speaking of which, did you find out what happened?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I have to say that nothing has been clearly revealed.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: However, I do have a plan for what to do in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... I feel like I'm part of that plan.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's sharp... . Hehehe, what do you think, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choose an answer)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's sincere. Good answer.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay. Well then, let's give a briefing while I'm away.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Let's summarize the information so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choose someone to talk to)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The gate that Lord Bjor's patrol fleet discovered by chance in the open sea was the beginning of everything.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A gate that is not registered on the route. Lord Bjor decided to conduct a forced reconnaissance.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: On the other side of the gate, there was a beautiful plain filled with flowers all the way to the horizon.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: It was a beautiful, but somewhat strange place.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: This is all that Lord Bjor and other imperial soldiers remember exactly.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The story behind this is very confusing and fragmentary.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We must uncover the identity of the person who dared to make fun of the empire's flag and mock our soldiers, who are also subjects of the empire.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Yes! Such vicious atrocities must be an evil wizard with evil intentions in the world! I will not forgive you!

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Evil wizard…d.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (It would be nice if the story were like that, but...)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: We investigated the magic used and resolved the effects of the magic that had taken hold of the imperial soldiers.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The type of magic that makes up magic... It was a very old, ominous thing with a religious feel to it.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I didn't know exactly who's magic was, but

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: One thing is certain, the magician instantly captured the hearts of most of the Imperial soldiers.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The magic that took control of the hearts of countless people in an instant... This is a difficult feat for any archmage.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Beyond the human realm... I have a feeling that some powerful being is behind it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The culprit behind this incident... You'll have to face it directly to find out, but it's not something you can't guess.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Even after the Demon King was defeated, all kinds of chaos arose, and there was a time when it seemed like Freios might be destroyed.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Such chaos continued until the first empire appeared.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Most of the chaos was brought about by humans themselves, but not everything was like that.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: For example… Ancient gods of darkness, different from the ancient gods we believed in.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There is a [Demon World] that they created.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Horse egg… No, this is too long a story. We'll talk about it next time.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Anyway, the ancient evil was mostly driven out of this world when the ancient empire rose to the rock.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The cause of this incident is… Isn't it touching on those ominous, old memories? That's how I feel.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay, then I'll make the request.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I want you to go to the Belfar Library now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belpa?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's a library. It is also a temple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? It’s both a library and a temple… ?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: When you go, you'll find out what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What's important is that among the magical artifacts there, there is one that is presumed to be a duplicate of the one the imperial army unearthed on the plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: There is a high probability that the relics in Belfa were also robbed.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: … I vaguely remember giving such an order when I was out of my mind. The soldier who received the order was a truly outstanding soldier, and he undoubtedly completed his mission. … Unfortunately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… Oh my.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Whether or not the artifact has already been stolen, you may be able to obtain additional information from Belfar. It might be a good idea to start there first.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Well then, I want you to leave for Belfar first, check the remaining evidence and do whatever you think is necessary.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Adventurer, who received a request from the Guild Association, said he was going, so the librarian from Belpa will help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, thank you!

choices.text: 2. As long as the compensation is sufficient.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hehe, you're surprisingly knowledgeable about this subject. If things go well, there will be a reward from the imperial court.

choices.text: 3. Let’s punish the guy who mocked Lord Bjor!

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, that much for someone I just met... ?

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: This Maximilien Hadonfar Vlamediath Haronach Dondekman Darth Vader's Villot III. I was thrilled!!!!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It’s been a while since my full name came out. Thanks to you, Lord Bjor has regained his strength. haha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Huh? ‘Go go scene’… What does this mean? Anyway, it seems like he's getting impatient because he can't progress the story quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, hello. Are you a librarian here?

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: (Nod) People from the Guild Union?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please... .

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: (Poof) Please come this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, uh… ? (He is grabbed by the arm and dragged away. He is a very impatient person.)

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: Fel, the person you've been waiting for has arrived.

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: No escape from reality. (Poof)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Quack? My Precious! My book, my book, is flying in the air!?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ah, Liz… . sorry. I lost my mind for a moment. A tense scene unfolds in which Mrs. Blanket's [Garterbelt Assassination Art] strikes the third base line and deals a fatal blow to the enemies' dining manners... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … Even if it is a defective book, this book is the library's property, not yours. And what do you mean, losing your mind at a time like this? Fel, you are banned from reading until this situation is resolved.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yeah, like that!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh my... … … … I can't help it. all right.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But what about those people?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: These are the Adventurer members of the Guild Alliance that we have been waiting for.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, I see! hello! Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This is Fel, the head librarian of our Belfar Library. Please call me Liz.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh yes. Hello Mr. Pell and Liz.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you heard the story... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh yes, you would like to see the ancient elven magic artifacts we have stored away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elf...?) Yes, that's right. Are the artifacts safe? Maybe it was stolen... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Actually, we are curious about that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… What's going on?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes, actually, after receiving the call, the director went into the [Secret Library] to check the relics, but he hasn't returned yet.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: And suddenly monsters started rampaging inside the library.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This place in Belpa... . In particular, the magic reading room used to be haunted by creatures whose origins were books and relics, but there was never a case like now.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: In addition, there is a [secret library] that contains the relics you are looking for... There is something powerful heat and magic swirling inside.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Unfortunately, this week is our volunteer week, and most of our librarians are away from the library.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The remaining few people decided that it was too dangerous to approach the library, so they were put on standby.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: In the secret storage room, there was a director and an elf wizard who came to investigate something... I'm worried about whether the samurai will do it.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Well, the director is not an easy person, but he is still an older person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Well then we should hurry. Did you say it was a secret library? Where is the entrance?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you go into the [Magic Reading Room] this way and go all the way, you will find the entrance.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Even though it is a secret library, the entrance is not hidden, so you will be able to find it easily.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please, be careful!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Have they appeared again, the intruders... !!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fire spirit, and a very powerful one!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is this feeling like I'm running out of control? I don't think there's anything that looks like anger... Oh my, this library looks like it's going to catch fire at any moment!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: You sneaky robbers, I won’t miss you!!!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Experience the wrath of Ifrit!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Huh, these guys are quite capable... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've calmed down a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, wait, we're not thieves! I came here at the request of the Belpa librarians!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: … I don't think it's a lie...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew, that’s good. I was wondering what would happen if we kept fighting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey. I heard that the director of the Belfar Library came here before us. Where is he?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … No way… . It was charred in the fire... .

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: That's not true, she is the head of the shamans. It has great power.

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: She ran after the thief. I don't know where it went...

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: … … The thief who stole the Book of Shadows that I was protecting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… . Are you like a guardian of a relic?

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: That's right. To my shame, I couldn't keep my contract... .

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Ugh, forcing myself to come out again and talk makes my seal ache, my bones feel cold… ! I guess I'll just have to be sealed again.

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Hello. Strong human warriors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … … … … … It hurts to the core. Is the seal like rheumatism?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, first I have to tell the people waiting in the lobby what I found out.

steps.name: To the forgotten plains
steps.objective:
1. Finish the conversation with [Fell] and [Liz] in the “Belfar Library” and go to the “Forgotten Plains” through the portal in “Hollow Sea 4”.
2. Talk to the “Elite Partisan” in the “Forgotten Plains” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Eh… . A thief in a secret library.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I see... . It's a big deal to have the relic taken away, but I'm glad the director is safe.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: By the way, the guardian of the book is Ifrit, a high-ranking fire spirit. That's kind of a messed up idea. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We, the librarians of the Belf faction, are guardians of knowledge, especially [books], and that is why we are experts at handling fire. Fel.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well, that's the case.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Well, I admit that it is definitely a unique idea. Fel, I see there is another librarian just as good as you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes? Hehehe, what am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't think it's a compliment)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Anyway, I feel like I owe you an apology.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Apology? By any chance, is the stolen relic what we are looking for?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: As you might guess, the book that Ifrit protects is the [Book of Shadows], the relic you are looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Book of Shadows... It's a name that makes me feel like a magic book.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: That's right. In related literature, it is said that the Book of Shadows has the power to banish an object from [reality] to the world of [shadow].

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It also says [Piece of Destruction created to prevent the destruction of the world]. Does this mean ‘suppressing poison with poison’?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If this book was stolen by someone with bad intentions... It will be a big disaster.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: … … Wow, it was such a scary thing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… . The problem is getting more serious and heavy... I absolutely hate it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I don't think there's any reason to stay in Belfar any longer. I have to go after the person who stole the relic.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: What do you plan to do in the future?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well. I plan to go to the unidentified gate that the imperial army discovered in the open sea.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Unidentified gate! You never know what danger lies ahead. My heart is pounding... ! Good luck!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: May Leda protect your path ahead.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Another enemy... Well, no more... . It might be too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, we are not your enemies.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: You must be… . I met him on an airship.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. You were the soldier next to Sir Björ at that time, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to be so guarded. There was a story behind the fight with Lord Bjor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a mark given to me by someone named Lena Hiren, and she said that if you see this, you will trust me... How do you feel?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Hiren… It must be the name of a family that is one of the empire's leading nobles... Ah, this… !!!

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: This is the symbol of the imperial family’s special organization [Silver Claw].

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: … It is the duty of an Imperial soldier to cooperate with the bearer of this emblem... Yes. Okay. Please tell me anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. I'm glad the story turned out well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So first of all, you were the one who broke into the Belfar Library and took the artifacts, right?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: … That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Björ's orders were not his own. It is said that an unidentified magic controlled Lord Bjor and many imperial soldiers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must return two artifacts: one that was excavated in El Anor Plains and another that was taken from the library. Please give it to me.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: The captain has been controlled by magic... You said?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: … … … … Yeah, I see... . When you think about it that way, it makes sense.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: When I think about it, there were more than one or two things that seemed suspicious, such as strange feelings from colleagues around me... I was a fool... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Sorry. I don't have those artifacts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? then… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you got hurt a lot... ! If so, then... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: It's probably just as you imagine. I followed the instructions and entered the [Painter] where the person to deliver the artifact was supposed to be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Painter… Is that what you see over there the entrance to the flower garden?)

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: However, there was no opponent waiting, and what appeared were numerous monsters... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: They managed to escape, but the artifact was lost during the escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, then I guess the relics are still in that garden.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: There is a possibility that this is not the case, but we need to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know who requested that the relic be brought back?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: The only orders I received were to bring the artifact here... Other than that I don't know anything.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: You don't seem to be Adventurer people of extraordinary skill.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Please. Would you please retrieve the relics from that garden?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: If those relics fall into the hands of those who oppose the empire and are misused, it will be a big problem... !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I plan to do so even if you don’t ask me to. Get yourself together here.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Thank you. You have no shame... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, the only thing you did wrong was to follow orders. Don't be too hard on yourself.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: … thank you

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Well then, I wish you luck.

steps.name: Suspicious Flower Garden (1)
steps.objective: In the "Forgotten Flower Garden", defeat the monster "Ceroberus" mentioned by [Degos] and report the quest to the missing wizard [Soreille].

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Wow, this is my first time meeting you. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Adventurer… Are you taking it in? An aimless journey in this wonderful season... . That's good. I also want to go somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello, are you… .

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Alas, I forgot to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: My name is Degos. He is the owner of this place. Please take care of me.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to say it with my own mouth, but it's a beautiful flower garden, right? This place is my pride.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh yes, it's a really cool place. It has a gorgeous yet rustic feel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The plain in front of here also looks so peaceful and happy... This area is really beautiful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But for some reason, I don't feel like I'm popular... Maybe it's because it's a quiet countryside.)

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to the good and sincere citizens, this land is quite livable.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: As an incompetent lord, I can only feel both thankful and sorry to the people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . You are the lord of this land.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's a good thing. I can ask this person about this land.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, but I have to ask...

lines.speaker: 짐승의 울부짖음
lines.text: Gooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hmm, is that monster going on a rampage again? If he goes on a rampage now, there's no way to stop it. It's a big problem... !

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Oh no, I was so distracted I forgot to warn you. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: This flower garden is very dangerous now. Monsters are appearing everywhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Monster? (Are you referring to the monsters the guerrilla guy was talking about?)

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: That's right. While hunting with my men on the plains near the flower garden, a huge monster suddenly appeared.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I didn't know how to force them into this flower garden, but many small monsters that seemed to be the devil's minions appeared...

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I managed to defeat it, but my subordinates were seriously injured. Now I've sent them to cheer up the team.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Honestly, it feels a bit overwhelming... If he escapes from the garden and harasses the people, wouldn't it be a big problem? As the lord, I have to do something. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: We would welcome you to visit the garden when it becomes peaceful. It's better to stay away now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, if that's the case, I'd like to help you.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hmm? Are you helping me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I would like you to leave it to me to exterminate monsters.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: … … That's great! I was impressed!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Taking risks for others is an incomparably noble attitude... !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, so noble... It's not that great.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: No, there is no need to be humble. Not everyone can risk themselves for others like you do.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Um… .

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: In fact, it is right for me and my men to solve the problem, but it is true that neither my soldiers nor I are very used to fighting.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: It's been a long time since there was a conflict in this land... I don't even know if I can fight properly, so it's extremely embarrassing.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I actually knew at first sight that you guys were powerful Adventurer. I'm sure it would be okay for you.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: As a lord, I am truly embarrassed... . Despite my shame, I would like to ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Please wipe out the monsters in the flower garden and defeat the three-headed monster dog that appears to be the leader.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: This is for the safety of our citizens, so if you can resolve this matter, I will show my best sincerity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will do my best.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Well. I'll be waiting for good news. Good luck!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Well then, wait here. Be careful!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, let’s go!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...But, I feel like I'm missing something from earlier... What is it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure. Maybe it's because the weather is so nice... I feel like my head is not working well...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And the scent of this flower…isn’t the scent of the flower garden too…scent…?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Hmm, is it hot? If you don't come to your senses.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on, let's go!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Gooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the crying I heard at the entrance... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are the culprit!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Grrrrrrrrrrr!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry! I need to be quiet!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Off...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, that was a tough fight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Too bad I can't let him run away any longer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry… !!!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Kneung, keuung…

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Just a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: No! Don't hurt that puppy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, Mr. Platinum?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … A puppy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this Cerberus raised by Mr. Platinum? .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … It's quiet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my gosh.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Come on, I'll free you now... !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A soft light spreads from Mr. Platinum….!)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Phew, I think it went well... !

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cerberus turned into a woman! Those long ears... Are they the elves seen in Midgard?)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oh my, I can't come to my senses, I must have been so shocked. What should I do… .

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Uh, um… . no… .

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: I can't eat dessert anymore. Mmmmmnya.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Ouch!

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Uh… Oh my?

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Ph… Platinum?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … phew. You came to your senses. Soreille.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: So… . good morning?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: No!!!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I dreamed that I was a dog with wings. I ran and played among the pretty flowers in the refreshing breeze.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wasn’t it a dream about eating dessert? …That dessert was me!!….)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ugh… It's like Soreille.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Soreyu… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Platina, Mr. Soreille...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Huh? Do you know Soreyu?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the elf wizard Soreille who disappeared from the Belfa library? ?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Eh… missing. Oh my... . It's a big deal.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This is your story... . Please wake up from your sleep, lady!

steps.name: Suspicious Flower Garden (2)
steps.objective: Find out the identity of [Degos] in the “Forgotten Flower Garden” and fight for victory. Then report the quest to [Elite Ranger] in “Forgotten Plains”.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: … … Oh my god, I, I… … ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ha, wow... all.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: … Yes, you guys win!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: But that doesn't mean I'll like it too much.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Although not completely, the seal on this land has been broken... The obstacle that blocked the demon world and this world has disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … what… ?

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: … I will be back. Come back, make sure to catch you guys! I'd rather kill you! I’ll make you beg!!!!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hahahahahaha… . Let’s wait happily for the day of our reunion…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Damn it, I'll deal with you anytime, so get the hell out of here now... !

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Ohhhhhhh------

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you returned to the demon world? Or is it sealed? Phew. anyway… . It went off though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all... It would be a good idea to join the Platinums.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thanks to this, we were able to defeat the main culprit who bewitched the imperial army and robbed the magical artifact.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: However, the magic that separated this land, which was eroded by the Demon World, from the world has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … … Umm… The problem has become serious.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Now this area is out of this world... I'm back as part of Freios.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: At the same time, the demon world that was encroaching on this area also became connected to this world.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … Ah, the road ahead will be difficult.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: First, we have to solve the problem in front of us.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: First, we must stabilize the dark power that has covered this garden so that it does not leak out.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'll help you too, Platinum.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Um, then… Thank you so much for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… But it doesn't seem to help... .

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: I'm really sorry... It's all because of me... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Come on, what are you saying? Thanks to defeating Degoth, things didn't turn out to be the worst.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: That's right. If the Demon Lord had turned the entire area into a [gate] leading to the demon world and opened it wide, it would have been a truly terrible situation.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thanks to Degos being defeated before that, there was a hole in the dike filled with water... It has been resolved.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Okay, okay. Try not to be disappointed by the parts you haven't reached.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The same goes for the soldier there. I didn't do anything right, but there's nothing wrong with it either.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: … Ha, is that so… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, something like that. You have to do what you can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, in this world where the devil is in danger in front of the [Demon King], there is only one added danger. Eng.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you keep messing around, everything will blow up, you guys.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, yes! That momentum! Ahaha. Adventurer who are fighting against the Demon King should not be scared by something like this!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: [Demon King]… . I heard the situation from Platina, but alas, the name I heard only in fairy tales became reality... .I suddenly feel dizzy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, I have to tell the whole story to the people of the Guild Alliance and Lena from the Empire. Is it okay for you two? What about the soldier man?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yeah, thanks to that, this place isn't that dangerous either. Don't worry, go! We will take care of this friend and send him back.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Although [Book of Shadows] and [Staff of Destruction] were destroyed, it is fortunate that they were not completely exploited. Thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you so much. Please let me repay this favor at any time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… What is grace? Oh… . See you next time then. be careful.

steps.name: Report on request
steps.objective: Visit [Lena] at the “Guild Inn” and report that you have completed the request.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Degos, the lord of the sealed earth... . It is one of the great evils that terrified Freios during the Second Age.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It is a road that connects the demon world and this world... , it has become a big deal.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: ('The storm of despair blackens the sky, and hope will come silently like a feather in the strong wind'... the Queen said.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (Could this incident also be an omen that they are the Adventurers of Fate?)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think you should meet the queen as soon as possible and talk to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Queen… . You mean the one who rules the empire?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: In fact, the reason I came here, according to the Queen's orders, was to welcome you to this land and take you to the Queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh? He knew I was coming here?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, you will know when you meet him, but he is a mysterious person.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll tell you as soon as I'm ready. This job was really hard work.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You really did a great job as soon as you came to this town. I was impressed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, well… . Anyone would have done that in that situation... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh my, how humble you are.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: (As a wizard, I wish I had a chance to travel and explore the world with outstanding Adventurer people like this person, but heh, I somehow feel like the opportunity will come.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text:
(Even in the face of such a huge incident, his calm demeanor...
It seems as if he has something much more important to overcome than this.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (I wonder why, when I look at those Adventurer... I get the feeling that there will be some huge change in the fate of us [Storm Watchers].)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Is this a simple illusion, or a foresight as a [Observer]...?)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Heh… . Time will tell... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Mr. Einst… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if this continues, I won't be left with any regrets.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, you should get some rest. … Well, anyway, it was rewarding. Haha… .
